suggestions.explanation: At 3× traffic in “Black Friday”, HPA hits its maximum of 10 at 92% CPU of request (target 70% CPU of request). Up to 4,006 messages waited while replicas started. Raise the maximum to 14. A rerun with this change confirmed it.
